subject: GCP seller intake & procurement workflow — mapping SKUs, PO process, and co-sell ops
messages:
From: Linda Meyer <linda.meyer@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller intake — initial procurement questions

Thanks, Stephanie — excited to get the listing live. A couple quick procurement items before we proceed to GCP listing steps:

1) Our procurement team requires a single-line invoice format and a Marketplace SKU mapping sheet to map our internal product codes to GCP SKUs.
2) We need confirmation on whether Redwood supports customer PO + invoice flow (net-30) for Marketplace purchases vs. direct billing.
3) Can you confirm required contact for SOC2 evidence? Our security team will request a copy during onboarding.

Attaching our internal SKUs (CSV) and the PO template we use. If you can point us to the exact billing contract or Marketplace terms, that’ll speed things up.

Thanks — Linda
Linda Meyer
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp

Attachments: acme-mfr-sku-mapping.csv, PO-template-acme.docx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Linda Meyer <linda.meyer@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller intake — initial procurement questions

Hi Linda — thanks for the details and the attachments. Short answers below, and I’ve outlined next actions so we can keep the onboarding window tight.

- Invoice/PO flow: Redwood supports Marketplace-driven billing (Google invoices customers) as well as direct billing via our Dedicated plans. For Marketplace purchases specifically, GCP handles customer invoicing; however we can support a pass-through PO workflow if Acme needs Redwood to accept POs and invoice Acme directly (this requires an enterprise billing addendum).

- SKU mapping: attached is a recommended mapping template (gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx) and an example from a recent seller. If you send the CSV with internal SKUs we’ll map to preliminary Marketplace SKU placeholders and share the draft.

- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II summary report and point your security team to our SOC evidence portal. Karthik will coordinate the evidence handoff and redaction process.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ben will take the SKU CSV and produce a sku->marketplace mapping by 11/03.
2) Acme procurement to indicate preferred invoicing path (Marketplace vs Redwood invoice) and provide billing contact.
3) Karthik to drop SOC2 access link and short checklist.
4) I’ll own the DocuSign for the marketplace listing contract and the SOW signature path.

Can we aim for the initial mapping and procurement decision by EOD 11/03 so we can submit the listing manifests by 11/06?

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference

Attachments: gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Meyer <linda.meyer@acme-corp.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller intake — initial procurement questions

On Mon, Nov 1, 2026 at 10:42 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Ben will take the SKU CSV and produce a sku->marketplace mapping by 11/03.

Hi all — I pulled the CSV and started a first pass. A few notes:
- There are three product SKUs that are per-seat vs per-instance; Marketplace usually wants usage metric defined up front. I’ve added a column for suggested GCP pricing metric in the attached mapping.
- For the PO flow: if Acme wants Redwood to accept POs and invoice Acme directly we’ll need procurement's standard W-9 and tax info (US). Linda, can you share that?
- I’ll need a short description (1–2 lines) for each SKU for the GCP listing manifest.

I’ll upload the draft mapping to the shared Drive folder and flag the rows we need ACME to confirm.

Ben Carter
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-mfr-sku-mapping-draft.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-gcp-seller-intake

> - W-9 and tax info: attached.

Attached: Acme_W9.pdf

> - PO flow: Acme prefers to issue a PO and have Redwood invoice Acme directly (net-30).

We can confirm net-30 and will send the PO once Redwood confirms invoicing contact and tax details.

> - SKU descriptions: we’ll provide 1–2 line descriptions by close of day.

We’ll aim to get those now. Also requesting SOC2 access — copying our security lead (alex.j@gcp-partner.com) to coordinate.

Linda

Hi team — quick status update before I close the circle: 

- Ben completed SKU mapping and flagged 4 lines that need Acme descriptions (Ben’s drive link).
- Linda confirmed Acme prefers PO -> Redwood invoice (net-30). Procurement will send PO after we provide W-9 and Redwood tax contact (Ben: please confirm we have tax contact info on file).
- Karthik uploaded the SOC2 summary; Alex confirmed scope and requested three redacted items (we’ll return the full report within 4 business days once NDA is signed).
- I’ve prepared the DocuSign PowerForm and sent the marketplace listing contract to Acme for signature (DocuSign link below). Please review the SOW draft in the Drive and comment if any delivery milestones need adjustment.

Timeline: submit GCP manifests 11/09, listing validation window 11/10–11/12, go-live target 11/18 (assuming sign-offs on PO + DocuSign).
